name: lycoris;lastwords
source:
Deliver three recently departed souls to the afterlife -- and keep their thoughts comforted. as best you can, at least.

[From [url=https://robobarbie.itch.io/lycorislastwords]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
將三個剛剛離世的靈魂送往彼岸，並盡力安撫他們的心緒。至少，盡你所能。

[摘自[url=https://robobarbie.itch.io/lycorislastwords]itch.io[/url]]
